name: Chinng Lab AI-Agent Portal
description: AI-agent-first content hub serving news, CVE advisories, and Japanese/US government documents metadata-first over MCP and REST, plus an Agent-Readiness directory scoring how well other sites expose agent surfaces.
content:
# Chinng Lab AI-Agent Portal

An AI-agent-first content hub. Crawlers ingest articles three times a day and an asynchronous worker enriches them with LLM summaries, machine translation to English, and knowledge-graph entity lookup. Everything is served metadata-first — title, summary, entities, related links — so agents can filter before fetching bodies. Article bodies are gated per each item's redistribution license: first-party content is served in full, third-party sources are link-only.

## Key Focus Areas

- News articles (`news/`) — crawled and enriched with `summary_en` as the English pivot
- CVE and security advisories (`security/`) — vulnerability feed with its own sitemap
- Government documents (`government/`) — Japanese agencies and the U.S. Federal Register, with provenance fields
- Agent-Readiness directory — scores other domains 0–100 across Discoverability, Content, Bot Access Control, API/Auth/MCP/Skill, and Commerce, mapped to Level 0–3
- Citation Packs — per-article attribution, license, content hash, and reuse policy at `/citations/<id>.json`

## Agent Surfaces

- **MCP server**: `https://portal.chinng-lab-srv.dev/mcp` (streamable-http, eight tools)
- **MCP Server Card**: `/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json`
- **AI catalog** (Agentic Resource Discovery): `/.well-known/ai-catalog.json`
- **API catalog** (RFC 9727 linkset): `/.well-known/api-catalog`
- **Agent Skills index**: `/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json`
- **REST, no auth**: `/api/search`, `/api/government`, `/api/popular`, `/api/changes`, `/api/surfaces`
- **Markdown views**: every article is `text/markdown` at its canonical URL; category feeds at `/feeds/<category>.md`

## About llms.txt Implementation

The portal's `llms.txt` documents the full read surface — MCP tools, REST endpoints, the license model that governs body exposure, and the incremental-monitoring pattern via `content_hash` change detection — so an agent can go from discovery to a correctly attributed citation without scraping HTML. `llms-full.txt` expands this with the complete endpoint and schema detail. Sitemaps are split by content family (`sitemap_news.xml`, `sitemap_cve.xml`, `sitemap_government.xml`, `sitemap_sites.xml`) so agents never mix categories.

description: Open spec for how services communicate operational limits to humans and agents: limits discovery, structured refusals, conformance levels.
content:
# Graceful Boundaries

Graceful Boundaries is an open specification (CC-BY-4.0) for how HTTP services communicate operational limits — rate limits, quotas, auth, payload size — to humans and autonomous agents. It extends RFC 9457 problem-details with a structured refusal vocabulary, defines a limits-discovery endpoint, and specifies four conformance levels (L0–L4).

## Key Focus Areas

- Operational-limit communication
- Agent-safe HTTP error responses
- Conformance checking via `npx graceful-boundaries check <url>`

## About llms.txt Implementation

The llms.txt at gracefulboundaries.dev points to the spec, the RFC 9457 profile, the conformance checker, and worked examples — the minimum context an agent needs to either implement the spec or interpret a conformant service's responses.

name: Perpensum
description: Open definition of agent-directed manipulation: what counts as web page text placed to steer a machine reader, with a conformance suite and a reference implementation.
content:
# Perpensum

Perpensum publishes a definition separating agent-directed manipulation — text placed on a web page to steer an AI reader's judgment — from legitimate machine-readable self-presentation such as structured data, llms.txt, and ordinary marketing copy. Classification uses two mechanically decidable axes, region (first-party or third-party) and visibility (visible or hidden), and no subjective axis, so independent implementations reach the same verdict on the same page.

## Key Focus Areas

- Definition of agent-directed manipulation, in English and Japanese
- Severity derived from region and visibility, with no judgment of intent or tone
- Conformance suite of 18 cases, 13 of which expect no finding
- Dependency-free reference implementation, runnable as `curl -s <url> | node scan.mjs`
- Stated limits: external CSS is not fetched, runtime JavaScript is not evaluated, region detection is inference

## About llms.txt Implementation

The llms.txt indexes the definition, its structured JSON form, the conformance suite, and the reference implementation. llms-full.txt carries the complete definition in a single file. Both state the same content as the HTML pages: the definition holds that machine-readable self-presentation is legitimate and that serving different content to different readers is the practice it exists to name, so the site publishes identical content to every reader.

# Planomy

> Planomy is a free, local-first US personal-finance and retirement planner. Its browser-based tools model year-by-year cash flow, federal and state tax, Social Security, Medicare and IRMAA, required minimum distributions, Roth conversions, Monte Carlo outcomes and historical returns without requiring an account.

## Key Focus Areas

- Retirement planner — year-by-year projection of cash flow, tax, Social Security, Medicare and RMDs, run entirely in the browser
- Calculators — 37 focused calculators covering FIRE, Roth conversions, RMDs, IRMAA, take-home pay, debt payoff and college savings
- Guides — 34 plain-English guides to retirement, tax and personal-finance questions
- Tax data — dated, source-attributed IRS, SSA and CMS figures for 2026, also published as free JSON at /data/
- Local-first storage — plan data stays on the user's device unless they choose an account and cloud sync

## About llms.txt Implementation

Planomy publishes both `llms.txt` and `llms-full.txt`. Each entry pairs a page
with a one-line statement of the question it answers, so an assistant can route
a specific question — "what is my RMD this year", "which IRMAA bracket am I in",
"Roth or traditional" — to the single page that actually computes it rather than
to a generic landing page. The `/data/` entry additionally points at
machine-readable JSON of current US tax and retirement figures, each value
carrying a citation to the IRS, SSA or CMS publication it came from.

description: Brazilian manufacturer of commercial audio equipment — 70.7V amplifiers, multi-zone digital matrices, sectorizers, preamps with media center, acoustic speakers and line transformers for commercial sound systems
content:
# Sansara Eletrônica

Sansara Eletrônica is a Brazilian manufacturer of commercial audio equipment based in São Paulo, in continuous operation since 2002 (continuity of the Sankya brand). Produces line 70.7V amplifiers (constant voltage distribution systems), low-impedance power amplifiers, preamplifiers with integrated Media Center (FM/USB/SD/Bluetooth), multi-zone digital audio matrices, 70V sectorizers, redundancy switches, embedded and surface-mount acoustic speakers, sound projectors, line transformers and volume controllers.

## Product Lines

- **SL Line (70.7V amplifiers):** SL 100 / 200 / 400 / 600 / 1300 — for distributed sound systems in shopping malls, hospitals, hotels, schools, churches, restaurants, gyms, airports and auditoriums.
- **SK Line (low impedance amplifiers):** 16 models from 100W to 2400W RMS, 2Ω/4Ω/8Ω variants.
- **SPL/SPG Preamps:** integrated Media Center with FM, USB, SD card, Bluetooth, microphone with priority, automatic gong.
- **FLEXIO 8.16/8.8:** digital multi-zone audio matrix with programmable routing.
- **SS 300:** 70V analog sectorizer with 10 independent sectors + general call.
- **SMR 300:** automatic redundancy switch with priority hierarchy (paging > alarm > program).
- **Acoustic speakers:** coaxial ceiling speakers, surface-mount cubes, outdoor sound projectors, long-range horns.

## llms.txt Implementation

The llms.txt file at sansaraeletronica.com.br/llms.txt provides:

- **Vocabulary equivalences:** maps common technical terms (e.g., "70V amplifier", "constant voltage line") to specific Sansara product lines (SL, SK, SPL, SPG, FLEXIO, SS 300, SMR 300, STL transformers).
- **Product catalog:** complete list of all products organized by category with direct URLs.
- **Application sectors:** which products fit which commercial environments.
- **Brand context:** Sansara as continuity of Sankya since 2002, with preserved technical assistance.

The full version (llms-full.txt) includes detailed technical specifications, installation guidelines, and frequently asked technical questions mapped from Brazilian audio professional community discussions (Eletronica2002 Forumeiros, Som ao Vivo).

## About

- Founded: 2002 (originally as Sankya, rebranded preserving the same factory, technical team and product line)
- Location: São Paulo, SP, Brazil
- Industry: Commercial audio / commercial sound systems
- Market: B2B distributors, integrators, technical assistance partners across Brazil
- Brazilian alternative to imported brands like JBL Commercial, Bose FreeSpace, QSC AcousticDesign and Bosch/Electro-Voice

name: SwissCarInfo
description: Swiss vehicle type approval database with 731,000+ official records from OFROU/ASTRA. Search by type approval number, VIN, brand/model. Includes cantonal statistics, EV adoption data, market shares, aviation registry, and Euro NCAP ratings. Available in FR/DE/IT/EN.
content:
SwissCarInfo is the leading Swiss vehicle database containing over 731,000 official vehicle type approval records (Réception par type / Typenschein / Omologazione). Data is sourced directly from OFROU/ASTRA (Swiss Federal Roads Office) and updated daily.

Key features include vehicle search by Swiss type approval number (field 24), European approval, VIN/chassis number, or brand/model. The platform also provides comprehensive Swiss vehicle statistics including cantonal fleet data for all 26 cantons, electric vehicle adoption by municipality (2,148 communes), brand market shares, rental fleet analysis, Swiss aircraft registry (BAZL), and Euro NCAP safety ratings.

Available in French, German, Italian, and English. Offers a free AI search API for AI assistants at https://swisscarinfo.ch/api/v1/ai-search.

# UI Thing

## Key Focus Areas

- **Nuxt UI Components**: A large set of accessible components with clear examples and variants
- **CLI Scaffolding**: Add components (plus required utilities/config) via `npx ui-thing@latest`
- **Blocks & Templates**: Pre-built page blocks and patterns to assemble screens quickly
- **AI Assistant Support (MCP)**: An MCP server so tools like Cursor, VS Code, and Claude can fetch component source code, docs, dependencies, and install steps

## About llms.txt Implementation

UI Thing publishes both **/llms.txt** (fast navigation + essentials) and **/llms-full.txt** (full documentation context) so language models can reliably locate canonical docs, setup steps, and implementation details.

For deeper tool-driven workflows, UI Thing also provides an **MCP server** at `https://uithing.com/mcp`, exposing structured resources, tools, and guided prompts to help AI assistants work with UI Thing components, blocks, and documentation.
This makes it easy for developers using AI coding assistants to discover, understand, and implement UI Thing components directly within their coding environment.
